# FaceOff Copilot And Agent Instructions

1. Follow `template.md` and `check.md` in `BigBrainDevBros/.github`.
2. Keep all tracked file and directory names lowercase (except `CNAME`).
3. Format all commit messages as `type: word1 word2 word3` matching `^[a-z]+: [a-z0-9]+ [a-z0-9]+ [a-z0-9]+$`.
4. Never embed emojis or direct binary download links in Markdown files.
5. Keep `readme.md` and `readme.zh-cn.md` (and other localized readmes) synchronized when updating project documentation.
6. Run `node --check` on modified `js/*.js` / `assets/*.js` files and verify `CI` passes before pushing to `main`.
